<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Car insurer" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="customer" name="Customer">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>submit</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>done</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="notification" name="Notification department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkDocs</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>register</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="handling" name="Handling department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>checkIns</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assess</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>positive</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>phone</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>schedule</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reject</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>letter</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start" name="Claim needed" />
    <bpmn:task id="submit" name="Submit the claim" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkDocs" name="Check the documents for completeness" />
    <bpmn:task id="register" name="Register the claim" />
    <bpmn:task id="checkIns" name="Check the insurance" />
    <bpmn:task id="assess" name="Perform the assessment" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="positive" name="Assessment positive?" />
    <bpmn:task id="phone" name="Phone the garage to authorise the repairs" />
    <bpmn:task id="schedule" name="Schedule the payment" />
    <bpmn:task id="reject" name="Reject the claim" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge" />
    <bpmn:task id="letter" name="Send a letter to the customer" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="done" name="Claim complete" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start" targetRef="submit" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="submit" targetRef="checkDocs" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" sourceRef="checkDocs" targetRef="register" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f4" sourceRef="register" targetRef="checkIns" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f5" sourceRef="checkIns" targetRef="assess" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f6" sourceRef="assess" targetRef="positive" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f7" name="yes" sourceRef="positive" targetRef="phone" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f8" name="no" sourceRef="positive" targetRef="reject" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f9" sourceRef="phone" targetRef="schedule" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f10" sourceRef="schedule" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" sourceRef="reject" targetRef="merge" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="merge" targetRef="letter" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="letter" targetRef="done" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
